All done. Here's a summary of the work completed:

**Changes made:**

- **`studio/src/mas-repository.js`** — Added `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, parentPath)` method that strips trailing `-N` suffixes, scans all fragments under the parent path via the AEM search API, and increments a counter suffix until a free title is found. Updated `copyFragment()` to use it as a safety-net fallback when no `updatedTitle` is provided.

- **`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`** — Updated `showClone()` to await `generateUniqueTitle` and pre-populate `this.titleClone` before opening the dialog. Updated the clone dialog textfield `value` binding from `this.fragment.title` to `this.titleClone`.

- **`studio/src/editor-panel.js`** — Same two changes as above applied to the parallel editor panel component.

- **`studio/test/mas-repository.test.js`** — Added a `describe('generateUniqueTitle', ...)` block with 5 unit tests covering: no-collision returns canonical, single-collision returns `canonical-1`, double-collision returns `canonical-2`, suffix-stripping (`lucy-card-1` → canonical `lucy-card` → next free `lucy-card-2`), and search-error fallback returning `canonical-1`.

**`git diff --stat`:** 5 files changed, 102 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)
